why: N-coding is explicitly proposed as an extension and higher-dimensional variant of Dual Coding Theory, so its account belongs on the canonical Dual Coding Theory page.

The candidate is a narrower, physics-specific application of Multimodal Instruction, emphasizing that learners should process information through multiple modalities during collaborative problem solving rather than merely encounter a realistic simulation.

claims.verifier: The claim directly tests whether adding multiple representations during problem presentation improves learning, providing appropriately qualified evidence about when multimodal coding may not add gains.
